about: Which request headers of an upload collect keeps the values of (S2.3), each with the data/sizes.json cap of its value: the User-Agent, Accept-Language, the three low-entropy client hints, Origin and the Web Bot Auth headers by name, every Sec-Fetch-* header by prefix. Names are lower case. Every other header keeps only its name, in the list of names in arrival order: cookies, credentials, the Referer (a page URL can carry personal data in its query; Origin and the batch's URL say where the upload came from) and anything a proxy adds (X-Forwarded-For and the like hold addresses).
